name: loot-offers
title: Personal loot offers (/nmsloot)
description: On an NPC's death, its loot is rolled again for each group or raid member in the zone and offered in a personal loot window: keep, sell, tribute, bank, vault, destroy or pass from anywhere in the zone. Works with the NMS client add-on (RoF2) and the Hailstone client's personal loot window.
